patterns.name: unexpected-admin-group-grant
patterns.condition: An ordinary account is assigned Administrators from an unfamiliar source, while using admin commands, or as part of mass account grants
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: unauthorized use of a valid account with unexpected administrative group privileges

patterns.name: post-elevation-command
patterns.condition: An account just gained administrator privilege then executes administrator commands, or the privilege appears from an unknown source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1068 and T1078: unexpected elevation followed by privileged activity

patterns.name: unusual-admin-command
patterns.condition: Administrator command outside working/class hours from a previously unseen source
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: abnormal time and origin can indicate stolen credential use

patterns.name: cross-account-admin-use
patterns.condition: A user invokes a privileged command with another account's authority
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: another legitimate account's privileges are used

patterns.name: rapid-admin-regrant
patterns.condition: Removed administrator membership is rapidly restored
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1078: unexpected reinstatement of administrator privileges

patterns.name: privilege-review
patterns.condition: Unconfirmed administrator/group/privileged-action warning without sufficient combined evidence for denial
patterns.evidence: MITRE ATT&CK T1068 and T1078: an incomplete privilege signal warrants alert rather than automatic blocking
